title: Men's 800m World Rankings: October 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' men's 800m (600m–1000m) event ranking as of 27 October 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times. Short-track performances are included; this is a dated top-ten snapshot, not the complete athlete population.

source.name: World Athletics — Men’s 800m (600m–1000m) World Rankings
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-11-03 against the original official HTML retrieved directly with curl (HTTP 200 after browser fetch returned 403). Compared all ten names, countries, source places 1–10, ranking points and the 27 October 2026 reference date. IOC codes mapped to ISO-2: KEN/KE, ALG/DZ, CAN/CA, USA/US, IRL/IE, ESP/ES, GBR/GB, BEL/BE, FRA/FR. Scope is 800m (600m–1000m), including short-track performances for Lutkenhaus, English, Attaoui and Crestan. Top ten only; live source may change. Scores are ranking points, not race times or independent performance tests.
